message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-06 13:10 IST to 2026-09-07 13:10 IST (2026-09-06 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-07 07:40 UTC)

This independent scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`. Obvious aliases were normalized and duplicate component/version entries were merged. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated within the last 24 hours could be confidently matched to a component in the assigned DLL inventory. Fresh advisories found during the sweep affected unrelated products and were excluded; older DLL-related notices were also excluded rather than presented as new.

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services. MongoDB's first-party alerts page showed its newest CVE notices dated 2026-09-03, outside this scan window. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated in scope.

Sources checked included the [MongoDB Alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-us/), [Foxit Security Bulletins](https://www.foxit.com/support/security-bulletins.html), and public CVE/CERT reporting.

### Closing

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from new disclosures in this 24-hour scan. Continue routine dependency and vendor advisory monitoring; this result reflects publicly verifiable reporting available during the stated window.
